THE DECISION MOMENT

The decision happens after the try-on.

They've already found it. Picked their size. Put it on. Then comes the pause: “Does this actually work for me?”

  1. TRY — Garments selected on the floor and brought into the fitting room.
  2. PAUSE — Standing in front of the mirror, uncertainty creates hesitation.
  3. DECIDE — Shopper steps out with purchase clarity and confidence.
